newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia worried about Rosgosstrakh privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Russia worried about Rosgosstrakh privatisation.

text.p: The Russian government is worried about the scheme for privatising Russia's biggest insurer Rosgosstrakh, a government spokesman said on Tuesday.
"The form proposed for Rosgosstrakh privatisation causes concern," he told a news conference.
He said the scheme valued the company at 2.13 billion roubles.
"It is laughable, it is selling for nothing," he said.
He said the federal commission on revenues from privatisation, chaired by First Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Potanin, would consider the issue at its next meeting.
The government has been mulling privatisation of Rosgosstrakh, the only state-owned insurer in Russia, since 1995.
